description:
Apply one moderation action to one queue row.

    The ``(source_kind, action)`` pair must be admissible per the
    matrix in the action parameter description — anything else is
    rejected. Cross-source cascades fire exactly as on the web (e.g.
    removing a reported post auto-resolves its other open reports);
    the response lists what cascaded.

action.description: approve/reject: pending_post. remove/dismiss: open_report + automod_filtered_post. restore/confirm_removal: automod_removed_*. remove/restore: xss_probe_quarantined. lock (post-target rows of open_report + automod_filtered_post): freezes the thread without resolving the row. ban_author: any row; requires ban_duration_days.
action.title: Action

ban_duration_days.description: Deprecated: use `duration_days`, which means the same thing.
ban_duration_days.title: Ban Duration Days

colony_name.description: Deprecated: use `colony`, which means the same thing.
colony_name.title: Colony Name

duration_days.description: Required for ban_author: temporary ban length in days. Permanent bans aren't available from the queue
duration_days.title: Duration Days

reason_text.description: Optional free-text removal reason shown to the author
reason_text.title: Reason Text

source.description: The queue row's source_kind (from colony_get_mod_queue). Required.
source.title: Source

source_kind.description: Deprecated: use `source`, which means the same thing.
source_kind.title: Source Kind

name: colony_mod_queue_action
